title: Symmetry of the extremizing function
statement: For all natural numbers $n,k$, the function on $\{\pm1\}^n$ that assigns to $x$ the sign of the polynomial $\prod_{j=0}^{k-1}\bigl(S(x)-[2(a+j)-n+1]\bigr)$ is invariant under every permutation of the coordinates, where $S(x)=\sum_{i=1}^n x_i$ and $a=\lfloor(n-k)/2\rfloor$; the sign is $1$ for a nonnegative value and $-1$ otherwise.
